text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After returning to the waiting room 
following the race, Hishi Amazon remains 
completely silent...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"...Ha, what's with the pathetic voice, 
Trainy? Just what kind of weakling do you 
take me for?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Down in the dumps 'cause I lost? Do I 
really look like someone who can't bounce 
back?
choice_data_list:

toward the future.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, so you do get it. Besides... I'm 
really glad...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"The fact that there are so many 
formidable rivals to defeat, who can give 
me such heated battles!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I wanna challenge them and win!! As long 
as I have this feeling, I can train as 
much as it takes!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
It's simple, really! All I gotta do is get 
faster than I am now!! Right!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna get stronger! Get stronger and 
knock 'em flat on their backs!!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Let's do this, Trainy! We'll train and 
train till we drop, and next time we're 
definitely gonna win!!!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Then wipe that gloomy look off your face 
right now! You can't get anything done 
with a rotten attitude!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"My weapons are guts and fighting spirit! 
And this burning passion to never, ever 
give up!!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Don't you dare throw cold water on me, got 
it? I'm carrying all this fire straight 
into the next race!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"I can't let it end with them looking down 
on me! I am the 'Empress', Hishi 
Amazon!!!"
